name: GTA VI on PC: Release and Requirements
summary: Current platform status and what PC players can safely plan around.
description: Rockstar’s official platform listing for GTA VI names PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. It does not currently publish a PC release date, minimum specifications, PC feature list, or pre-order details. Treat third-party dates and system requirements as speculation until Rockstar posts an official listing.

steps.title: Check the official platform listing
steps.content: Use Rockstar’s GTA VI page to confirm currently announced platforms and release information.
steps.tip: An official store listing is stronger evidence than retailer placeholders.

steps.title: Treat PC requirements as unannounced
steps.content: There are no official minimum or recommended PC specifications to compare against. Wait for a Rockstar PC announcement before upgrading hardware for this game.
steps.tip: Do not rely on system requirements copied between fan sites.

steps.title: Recheck before making a purchase plan
steps.content: Check Rockstar Newswire and the official game page for a platform announcement, date, or PC feature details.
steps.tip: A console release date does not establish a PC release schedule.

requirements: Check Rockstar’s official game page for announced platforms and requirements.
commonMistakes: Buying hardware based on unofficial requirements.
Treating an unconfirmed date as an official release window.
